description: Traccar: a GPS tracking server for 200+ device protocols with live maps, geofences, reports and notifications, on the bundled PostgreSQL. Hardened by QuenchWorks: CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

IT-Tools: developer utilities in one web app (encoders, converters, generators, network and crypto helpers), served as a static SPA. Hardened by QuenchWorks as a minimal, nonroot, CVE-gated image, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
